prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling shipyard dock. On the far left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning casually against a rusted metal railing. Beside him, a coiled thick rope rests on the wooden planks, its fibers frayed and visible. In the center foreground, a welder in a dark apron crouches low, sparks faintly suggested near his hands as he works on a steel beam. A silver wrench lies discarded next to the welder, gleaming slightly in the wash. To the right of the welder, a foreman in a blue vest points firmly toward the horizon, directing attention to an incoming vessel. Standing beside the foreman is a young apprentice holding a clipboard, looking intently at the pointed direction. Perched atop a stack of crates near the center is a stray black cat, watching the activity with narrowed eyes. Below the crates, a brown dog sits patiently, its tail curled around its paws. A seagull flies overhead on the right, wings spread wide against the pale sky. Near the water's edge on the left, a fisherman in a green coat casts a net, his posture bent forward with effort. A wooden bucket sits next to the fisherman, half-filled with water. In the background, a large cargo ship looms, its hull painted white and red. A sailor in a striped shirt leans over the ship's railing, waving down to the dock. On the dock itself, a tourist in a floral dress takes a photo, her camera raised high. A small child in a red jacket runs past the tourist, chasing a rolling orange ball. Finally, a pile of loose bricks rests near the bottom right corner, stacked haphazardly. The welder looks at the steel beam while working. The foreman points at the cargo ship. The apprentice looks at the foreman. The black cat sits on the crates. The brown dog sits next to the crates. The fisherman stands next to the wooden bucket. There is no modern smartphone visible in anyone's hand. There is no bright sunlight casting harsh shadows.
